purpose: Separate text-free Prism HUD resources for transfer to the main project.

provenance.method: Painted PNG components mechanically separated from a newly generated transparent image_gen atlas based on the approved raster reference; not recovered original PSD/SVG layers.

legacySvg.status: Historical structural/coordinate references, not the editable source of current painted RGB artwork.
legacySvg.overwriteProtection: Legacy generator refuses to run while the painted transparent atlas exists.

notes: No new skill or role icon artwork; no baked text.
Badge-occluded rim segments continue adjacent painted rim pixels; occluded backplate extends clean side-panel pixels.
Gauge masks and full fills retain their canonical geometry and continuous pointed endpoints.

iconArtwork.policy: Reuse existing skill, class and role icons; this package only supplies empty artwork Images, frames and masks.

import.slice: Do not resize pointed or octagonal art with arbitrary nine-slicing.

boss.fillMode: clip the fixed full-width fill to the full inner polygon and the moving pointed end
boss.atFull: use complete inner polygon including both pointed tips

cast.fillMode: clip the fixed full-width fill to the full inner polygon and the moving pointed end
cast.atFull: use complete inner polygon including both pointed tips

player.fillMode: clip the fixed full-width fill to the full inner polygon and the moving pointed end
player.atFull: use complete inner polygon including both pointed tips

party.fillMode: clip the fixed full-width fill to the full inner polygon and the moving pointed end
party.atFull: use complete inner polygon including both pointed tips

layerOrder: optional existing artwork supplied by main project; new icons excluded

legacyVectorSources.status: Historical structural/coordinate references, not the editable source of current painted RGB artwork.
legacyVectorSources.overwriteProtection: Legacy generator refuses to run while the painted transparent atlas exists.

gauge: full-width fill clipped by live ratio
slot: existing game icon clipped by inner mask

bindings.party: AstellaPartyHUDV4.source and rows[]; retain existing callbacks and icon registry.

tools.import: Tools > Astella > Prism V4 > Import Sprites
tools.examples: Tools > Astella > Prism V4 > Build Example Prefabs
